description.en: Immediately places a character at a given position/rotation and sets its motion by name, combining CMND_SET_POSRY, CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG and CMND_SET_MOTION into one call.
Handle of the character to position.
4-element array [x, y, z, rotY] with the target position and Y rotation.
Motion name to set on the character.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Place the player character and set their standing motion
SetCharaPosAndMotName(hTenmaL, [_pos[0], _pos[1], _pos[2], _roty], "\x0097\x00a7\x0082\x00bf01");
